# spectrocloud-ingestor

Welcome to the SpectroCloud ingestor plugin!

[![npm latest version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@terasky/backstage-plugin-spectrocloud-ingestor/latest.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@terasky/backstage-plugin-spectrocloud-ingestor)

The `spectrocloud-ingestor` plugin for Backstage is a catalog entity provider that automatically ingests SpectroCloud Palette resources into the Backstage catalog. It discovers and creates entities for projects, cluster profiles, and clusters with proper relationship mapping.

For detailed docs go to https://terasky-oss.github.io/backstage-plugins/plugins/spectrocloud/overview
